name: wayne-code-review-flow
description: Formal static gate over one already-committed range: freeze base..head -> two independent voices (Claude + GPT) in parallel on shared criteria -> attributed synthesis -> PASS/FAIL. Portable across repos.

base.description: REQUIRED. Already-committed range to review, e.g. main..HEAD or HEAD~4..HEAD. A bare ref means <ref>..HEAD. Working-tree and untracked review is refused: the target must be nameable by SHA.
